title: Iourus Races
description: Iourus Races is a fantasy RPG-inspired Minecraft mod focused on racial identity, progression, and cultural gameplay. Instead of races being simple cosmetic choices, each one changes how you survive, fight, and interact with the world of Iourus.
body:
⚔️ Iourus Races

Forge your own identity in a medieval fantasy world where your race changes the way you play Minecraft.

Iourus Races is a fantasy RPG mod inspired by classic fantasy worlds and roleplaying systems. Instead of races being cosmetic only, every race comes with unique gameplay mechanics, strengths, weaknesses, and future progression paths that affect combat, exploration, crafting, and survival.

Designed for RPG and adventure modpacks, the mod aims to make each playthrough feel different depending on the race you choose.

🌍 Features
🧬 Playable Races

Choose between multiple fantasy races:

Human
Elf
Dwarf
Orc
Goblin

Each race has its own identity, gameplay advantages, and long-term design philosophy.

⚔️ Unique Racial Abilities

Every race includes passive bonuses and gameplay differences.

Current examples include:

Elves can move across leaves and have improved mobility.
Orcs gain increased combat power during battle.
Dwarves are designed around resistance, forging, and heavy equipment.
Humans focus on versatility and balanced gameplay.

The goal is to avoid simple stat upgrades and instead create meaningful playstyle differences.

🎮 Race Selection System
Custom race selection screen
Persistent race saving
Multiplayer compatible
In-game race selection
Designed for survival and RPG servers
⚒️ Planned Features

The mod is currently in active development. Planned systems include:

Cultural blacksmithing and forging systems
Race-exclusive weapons, armor, and tools
Racial crafting professions
Progression trees and specialization paths
Settlements, kingdoms, and structures
Reputation systems between races
Lore events connected to the world of Iourus
Compatibility with RPG, magic, and adventure modpacks
🛡️ Gameplay Philosophy

Races are designed around strengths and weaknesses rather than direct upgrades.

Your race will eventually influence:

Combat style
Crafting abilities
Equipment access
Mobility and exploration
Survival strategies
Multiplayer roles

The intention is to encourage cooperative gameplay and unique character identities in multiplayer worlds.

📖 About the World of Iourus

Iourus is an original fantasy universe filled with ancient kingdoms, mythical creatures, cultural conflict, and forgotten civilizations.

This mod is part of a larger interconnected project that aims to expand Minecraft into a living fantasy RPG sandbox while still preserving the creativity and freedom of vanilla gameplay.
